name: Zoui
source:
Race: Male human
Origin: Mirage Forest
Hobby: Eating, sleeping
Job: Traveller

Zoui is a boy with a natural affinity towards Crystalites. In OASE, Zoui can be found lurking in Mirage Castle looking for food. 

First appeared in Zeiva's early game series - Genetic Glow.
